app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Good but no lasting free version
body:
The app itself is nicely designed although I realised while using it - it’s impossible to track 2 activities simultaneously. One had to stop before the other one could be tracked which was a huge let down.

That and after a few days the free version just stopped and the app requested for me to pay for premium or get a free trial of the premium version.

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Bonne appli mais petit bémol
body:
L’application est vraiment riche et bien pensé mais le gros bémol reste l’impossibilité d’annuler une session.
(Ayant oublié cette nuit d’arrêter un chrono, je viens d’y passer sur l’appli 12h, et je ne vais pas pouvoir éditer ce temps de travail!)
Pour le prix que ça coûte on s attend à ce que cette fonctionnalité soit présente...
Bien à vous,

app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Positive changes!
body:
This app has been helping me concentrate on work for a set period of time instead of stretching 3 hours of tasks to take up the WHOLE DAY. 
I’m also finding it really useful for staying on track with things that have no external forces holding me accountable (reading, practicing instrument, flexible volunteering hours). I hope to get better about implementing it every day but so far I’m already seeing positive changes in my behavior!
